/*!
 * Pesona Kahuripan - Official Landing Page Stylesheet
 * Repository: https://github.com/pesonaku/landingpage
 */

:root {
  --key: #0f9d58;
  --key-dark: #0b7e46;
  --key-light: #e8f5e9;
  --dark: #0f172a;
  --black: #111827;
  --dark-gray: #374151;
  --text-muted: #6b7280;
  --white: #ffffff;
  --silver: #f8fafc;
  --gray: #e2e8f0;
  --border: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);

  --radius: 6px;
  --radius2: 12px;
  --circle: 1000px;
  --lebar: 1140px;
  --header_height: 72px;

  --card_shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05), 0 2px 4px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03);
  --hover_shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 10px 10px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
}

/* RESET & BASE */
*, *::before, *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0; padding: 0;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
body {
  background: var(--white);
  color: var(--black);
  min-height: 100vh;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}
img { display: block; max-width: 100%; height: auto; border: 0; }
a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: color 0.2s, background-color 0.2s; }
ul, ol { list-style: none; }
.wrapper { width: var(--lebar); max-width: calc(100% - 40px); margin: 0 auto; }

svg {

  fill: currentColor;

  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  line-height: 1;

/* HEADER & NAVBAR */
#header {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
body:not(#layout) #header {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0;
  height: var(--header_height);
  z-index: 1000;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  transition: height 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
}
body:not(#layout) #header.onScroll {
  height: 64px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07);
}
#header .wrapper {
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}
#header .header-section {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}
#header .logo {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  transition: transform 0.25s ease;
  height: 100%;
}
#header .logo:hover {
  transform: scale(1.02);
}
#header .logo img {
  max-height: 40px;
  width: auto;
  object-fit: contain;
  display: block;
}
#header nav.menu {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  height: 100%;
}
#header nav.menu ul {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  height: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
#header nav.menu ul li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  height: 100%;
}
#header nav.menu ul li a {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 14px;
  height: 40px;
  line-height: 1;
  font-size: 0.93rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.2px;
  color: #4b5563;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  transition: color 0.25s ease, background-color 0.25s ease;
}
#header nav.menu ul li a::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0px;
  left: 14px;
  right: 14px;
  height: 2.5px;
  background: var(--key);
  border-radius: 2px;
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: center;
  transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}
#header nav.menu ul li a:hover {
  color: var(--key);
  background: rgba(15, 157, 88, 0.06);
}
#header nav.menu ul li a:hover::after {
  transform: scaleX(1);
}
#header nav.menu ul li:last-child a {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--key), var(--key-dark));
  color: var(--white) !important;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 0 18px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 100px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(15, 157, 88, 0.28);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease;
}
#header nav.menu ul li:last-child a::after {
  display: none;
}
#header nav.menu ul li:last-child a:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(15, 157, 88, 0.38);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--key), var(--key-dark));
  opacity: 0.96;
}
.menu-toggle {
  display: none;
  background: #f8fafc;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
}
.menu-toggle:hover {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  border-color: #cbd5e1;
}
.menu-toggle svg,
.menu-toggle .hgi-stroke {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  font-size: 24px;
  fill: var(--black);
  color: var(--black);
  display: block;
}

/* HERO / COVER */
#cover { padding-top: var(--header_height); background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f0fdf4 0%, #ffffff 100%); }
.hero-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 0.85fr;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 40px;
  padding: 45px 0 50px;
}
.hero-badge {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  background: #e8f5e9; color: var(--key-dark);
  padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: var(--circle);
  font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 20px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(15, 157, 88, 0.25);
}
.badge-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  background: var(--key);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: inline-block;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(15, 157, 88, 0.25);
  animation: waStatusPulse 2s infinite ease-in-out;
}
.hero-content h1 {
  font-size: 2.5rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.25;
  color: var(--black);
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  letter-spacing: -0.5px;
}
.hero-content h1 span.highlight { color: var(--key); }
.hero-content p { font-size: 1.05rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 30px; line-height: 1.7; }
.hero-cta-group { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 15px; margin-bottom: 30px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.btn-cta {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 13px 28px;
  background: var(--key);
  color: var(--white);
  font-weight: 700;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(15, 157, 88, 0.35);
  transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.25s;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.btn-cta svg,
.btn-cta .hgi-stroke {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  font-size: 18px;
  fill: currentColor;
  color: currentColor;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}
.btn-cta:hover { background: var(--key-dark); transform: translateY(-2px); color: var(--white); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(15, 157, 88, 0.45); }
.btn-cta:hover svg,
.btn-cta:hover .hgi-stroke { transform: translateX(3px); }
.btn-secondary {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 13px 26px;
  background: var(--white);
  color: var(--black);
  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  box-shadow: var(--card_shadow);
  transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.btn-secondary svg,
.btn-secondary .hgi-stroke {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  font-size: 18px;
  fill: currentColor;
  color: currentColor;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}
.btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--silver); color: var(--key); border-color: var(--key); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.btn-secondary:hover svg,
.btn-secondary:hover .hgi-stroke { transform: translateX(3px); }
.hero-chips { display: flex; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--dark-gray); font-weight: 600; }
.hero-chips span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.hero-chips svg,
.hero-chips .hgi-stroke { width: 18px; height: 18px; font-size: 18px; fill: var(--key); color: var(--key); flex-shrink: 0; }
.hero-image-wrap { position: relative; }
.hero-image-wrap img { border-radius: var(--radius2); box-shadow: var(--hover_shadow); width: 100%; }
.hero-float-badge {
  position: absolute; bottom: -18px; left: -18px;
  background: var(--white); padding: 14px 22px;
  border-radius: var(--radius2); box-shadow: var(--hover_shadow);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); display: flex; flex-direction: column;
}
.hero-float-badge strong { font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--key); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; }
.hero-float-badge small { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 4px; font-weight: 600; }

/* SECTION COMMON */
.section-head { text-align: center; max-width: 650px; margin: 0 auto 36px; }
.section-badge {
  display: inline-block; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--key);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.section-head h2 { font-size: 2.1rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--black); margin-bottom: 12px; }
.section-head p { font-size: 1.05rem; color: var(--text-muted); }

/* ABOUT US (ZIG-ZAG) */
#about { padding: 65px 0; background: #ffffff; }
.about-section {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 45px;
}
.about-section .widget,
.about-section .widget-content {
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}
.about-section .widget > h2.title,
.about-section .widget > h3.title {
  display: none !important;
}
.about-item {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 50px;
  align-items: center;
}
.about-section > .widget:nth-child(even) .about-item,
.about-item:nth-child(even) {
  direction: rtl;
}
.about-section > .widget:nth-child(even) .about-item > *,
.about-item:nth-child(even) > * {
  direction: ltr;
}
.about-number {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--key-dark); background: var(--key-light);
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 100px; margin-bottom: 14px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(15, 157, 88, 0.2);
}
.about-item .about-text h3 {
  font-size: 1.7rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--black);
  margin-bottom: 14px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; line-height: 1.3;
}
.about-item .about-text p {
  font-size: 1.02rem; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 22px;
}
.about-features {
  list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;
}
.about-features li {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--dark-gray);
}
.about-features svg,
.about-features .hgi-stroke {
  width: 18px; height: 18px; font-size: 18px; fill: var(--key); color: var(--key); flex-shrink: 0;
}
.about-img-wrap {
  position: relative;
  padding: 10px;
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 36px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  transition: transform 0.35s ease, box-shadow 0.35s ease;
}
.about-img-wrap:hover {
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  box-shadow: 0 24px 48px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14);
}
.about-img-frame {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 310px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #e2e8f0;
}
.about-img-frame img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover;
  transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  display: block;
}
.about-img-wrap:hover .about-img-frame img {
  transform: scale(1.07);
}
.about-img-tag {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 20px; left: 20px;
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.88);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  color: #ffffff;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  border-radius: 100px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
}
.about-img-tag svg,
.about-img-tag .hgi-stroke {
  width: 16px; height: 16px; font-size: 16px; fill: #34d399; color: #34d399;
}

/* ================= 05. SERVICE / TIPE RUMAH PILIHAN ================= */
#service {
  padding: 65px 0;
  background: var(--silver);
  position: relative;
}
.service-section {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 22px;
  align-items: stretch;
}
#service-section > .widget,
.service-section > .widget {
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}
#service-section > .widget > h2.title,
#service-section > .widget > h3.title,
.service-section > .widget > h2.title,
.service-section > .widget > h3.title {
  display: none !important;
}
#service-section > #Text31,
#service-section > .widget.Text,
.service-section > .widget.Text {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  width: 100%;
  margin-bottom: 8px !important;
}
#service-section > .widget.Image,
.service-section > .widget.Image {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100%;
}
#service-section > .widget.Image > .widget-content,
.service-section > .widget.Image > .widget-content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100%;
  flex: 1;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;

#service-section > #Image35,
#service-section > #Image36,
#service-section > .widget[id*="Image35"],
#service-section > .widget[id*="Image36"],
.service-section > .widget[id*="Image35"],

    gap: 20px;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .service-section {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 18px;
  }
}

.service-card {
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: 18px;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.3s ease;
}
.service-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.09);
  border-color: #cbd5e1;
}

.service-card-img {
  height: 195px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  background: #f1f5f9;
}
.service-card-img img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transition: transform 0.45s ease;
}
.service-card:hover .service-card-img img {

        if (dotsContainer) {

            const dots = dotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.review-dot');
            dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
              dot.classList.toggle('active', idx === currentIndex);
            });
          }
        }

        function goToSlide(index) {
          currentIndex = (index + totalSlides) % totalSlides;
          updateSlider();
        }

        function nextSlide() {
          goToSlide(currentIndex + 1);
        }

        function prevSlide() {
          goToSlide(currentIndex - 1);
        }

        if (nextBtn) {
          nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            nextSlide();
            resetAutoSlide();

            resetAutoSlide();
          });

          touchEndX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;
          const diff = touchStartX - touchEndX;
          if (Math.abs(diff) > 40) {
            if (diff > 0) nextSlide();
            else prevSlide();
          }
          startAutoSlide();
        }, { passive: true });

        startAutoSlide();

      if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {

            if (entry.isIntersecting) {

      const unitSelect = renderEl.querySelector('#commUnitSelect');
      const priceInput = renderEl.querySelector('#commPriceInput');
      const dpNominalInput = renderEl.querySelector('#commDpNominal');
      const dpPercentLabel = renderEl.querySelector('#dpPercentLabel');
      const dpChips = renderEl.querySelectorAll('#dpChipsRow .calc-chip');
      const tenorRange = renderEl.querySelector('#commTenorRange');
      const tenorChips = renderEl.querySelectorAll('#tenorChipsRow .calc-chip');
      const tenorValLabel = renderEl.querySelector('#tenorValLabel');
      const bankSelect = renderEl.querySelector('#commBankSelect');
      const rateValLabel = renderEl.querySelector('#rateValLabel');

      const resultInstallment = renderEl.querySelector('#resultInstallment');
      const resultPlafon = renderEl.querySelector('#resultPlafon');
      const resultDp = renderEl.querySelector('#resultDp');
      const resultMinIncome = renderEl.querySelector('#resultMinIncome');
      const ctaCommWa = renderEl.querySelector('#ctaCommWa');

      let currentPrice = 435000000;
      let currentDpPercent = 10;
      let currentDpNominal = 43500000;
      let currentTenor = 20;
      let currentRate = 5.5;

      function updateCalculation() {
        currentPrice = parseDots(priceInput.value);
        if (currentPrice < 0) currentPrice = 0;

        currentDpNominal = parseDots(dpNominalInput.value);
        if (currentDpNominal > currentPrice) currentDpNominal = currentPrice;

        const plafon = Math.max(0, currentPrice - currentDpNominal);
        const installment = calcInstallment(plafon, currentRate, currentTenor);
        const minIncome = installment > 0 ? Math.round(installment / 0.35) : 0;

        if (resultInstallment) {
          resultInstallment.textContent = fmtRupiah(installment);
          resultInstallment.classList.remove('calc-pulse');
          void resultInstallment.offsetWidth;
          resultInstallment.classList.add('calc-pulse');
        }
        if (resultPlafon) resultPlafon.textContent = fmtRupiah(plafon);
        if (resultDp) resultDp.textContent = fmtRupiah(currentDpNominal);
        if (resultMinIncome) resultMinIncome.textContent = fmtRupiah(minIncome) + ' / bln';

        const unitText = unitSelect && unitSelect.value !== 'custom' ? unitSelect.options[unitSelect.selectedIndex].text.split('—')[0].trim() : 'Unit Komersial';
        const bankText = bankSelect ? bankSelect.options[bankSelect.selectedIndex].text : 'Bank Rekanan';

        const waMsg = `Halo ${marketingName}, saya ingin konsultasi simulasi KPR Komersial Pesona Kahuripan:\n\n` +
          `🏠 *Unit:* ${unitText}\n` +
          `💰 *Harga Properti:* ${fmtRupiah(currentPrice)}\n` +
          `💵 *Uang Muka (DP):* ${fmtRupiah(currentDpNominal)} (${currentDpPercent}%)\n` +
          `🏦 *Plafon KPR:* ${fmtRupiah(plafon)}\n` +
          `⏱️ *Tenor:* ${currentTenor} Tahun\n` +
          `📈 *Suku Bunga Bank:* ${currentRate.toFixed(2)}% (${bankText})\n` +
          `📊 *Estimasi Cicilan:* ${fmtRupiah(installment)} / bln\n` +
          `👥 *Estimasi Gaji Min.:* ${fmtRupiah(minIncome)} / bln\n\n` +
          `🌐 *Referensi Website:* https://www.pesonakahuripan.biz.id/#offer\n\n` +
          `Mohon dibantu info ketersediaan unit dan pengajuan berkasnya. Terima kasih!`;

        if (ctaCommWa) {
          ctaCommWa.href = `https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=${phone}&text=${encodeURIComponent(waMsg)}`;
        }
      }

      if (unitSelect) {
        unitSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
          if (this.value !== 'custom') {
            const val = parseInt(this.value, 10);
            priceInput.value = fmtDots(val);
            currentPrice = val;
            currentDpNominal = Math.round(currentPrice * (currentDpPercent / 100));
            dpNominalInput.value = fmtDots(currentDpNominal);
          }
          updateCalculation();
        });
      }

      if (priceInput) {
        priceInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
          const p = parseDots(this.value);
          this.value = p ? fmtDots(p) : '';
          currentPrice = p;
          currentDpNominal = Math.round(currentPrice * (currentDpPercent / 100));
          dpNominalInput.value = currentDpNominal ? fmtDots(currentDpNominal) : '';
          updateCalculation();
        });
      }

      dpChips.forEach(function(chip) {
        chip.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          dpChips.forEach(function(c) { c.classList.remove('active'); });
          this.classList.add('active');
          currentDpPercent = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-dp'), 10);
          if (dpPercentLabel) dpPercentLabel.textContent = currentDpPercent + '%';
          currentDpNominal = Math.round(currentPrice * (currentDpPercent / 100));
          if (dpNominalInput) dpNominalInput.value = fmtDots(currentDpNominal);
          updateCalculation();
        });
      });

      if (dpNominalInput) {
        dpNominalInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
          const dp = parseDots(this.value);
          this.value = dp ? fmtDots(dp) : '';
          currentDpNominal = dp;
          if (currentPrice > 0) {
            currentDpPercent = Math.round((currentDpNominal / currentPrice) * 100);
            if (dpPercentLabel) dpPercentLabel.textContent = currentDpPercent + '%';
            dpChips.forEach(function(c) {
              c.classList.toggle('active', parseInt(c.getAttribute('data-dp'), 10) === currentDpPercent);
            });
          }
          updateCalculation();
        });
      }

      tenorChips.forEach(function(chip) {
        chip.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          tenorChips.forEach(function(c) { c.classList.remove('active'); });
          this.classList.add('active');
          currentTenor = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-tenor'), 10);
          if (tenorRange) tenorRange.value = currentTenor;
          if (tenorValLabel) tenorValLabel.textContent = currentTenor + ' Tahun';
          updateCalculation();
        });
      });

      if (tenorRange) {
        tenorRange.addEventListener('input', function() {
          currentTenor = parseInt(this.value, 10);
          if (tenorValLabel) tenorValLabel.textContent = currentTenor + ' Tahun';
          tenorChips.forEach(function(c) {
            c.classList.toggle('active', parseInt(c.getAttribute('data-tenor'), 10) === currentTenor);
          });
          updateCalculation();
        });
      }

      if (bankSelect) {
        bankSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
          currentRate = parseFloat(this.value) || 5.5;
          if (rateValLabel) rateValLabel.textContent = currentRate.toFixed(2) + '% / thn';
          updateCalculation();
        });
      }

      updateCalculation();
    }
